capabilities.name: estate_home_context_resolution
capabilities.current_behavior: Backend resolves estate and home through authenticated memberships and validates requested scope.
capabilities.expected_behavior: Authenticated surface context is resolved and trusted.

capabilities.name: narrow_object_context_generalization
capabilities.current_behavior: Only some surfaces manually pass selected object context, especially the Consumer device drawer.
capabilities.expected_behavior: The narrowest valid object context wins across all modules unless the user explicitly widens scope.

capabilities.name: single_canonical_chat_path
capabilities.current_behavior: Consumer can receive answers from /oyi/chat, /ai/chat, or /oyi/runtime/conversation.
capabilities.expected_behavior: One canonical Oyi answer path remains primary; compatibility wrappers only adapt payload shape.

capabilities.name: thread_persistence
capabilities.current_behavior: Compatibility conversation threads and messages persist and can be restored.
capabilities.expected_behavior: Conversation continuity is retained across turns.

capabilities.name: device_scoped_conversation
capabilities.current_behavior: Consumer device drawer carries rich explicit device context and recent thread restoration.
capabilities.expected_behavior: Every object-bound surface should have the same scoped conversation contract.

capabilities.name: natural_language_generalization
capabilities.current_behavior: Intent routing is mainly regex-based with some stateful follow-up handling in compatibility chat.
capabilities.expected_behavior: Natural language should handle pronouns, corrections, shorthand, and informal phrasing consistently across modules.

capabilities.name: execution_confirmation_safety
capabilities.current_behavior: Pending confirmations and execution ledger exist, but confirmation ownership is split across /ai and compatibility /oyi chat.
capabilities.expected_behavior: One canonical action proposal and confirmation path gates all sensitive operations.

capabilities.name: awareness_consistency
capabilities.current_behavior: Backend authors awareness, but Consumer and Facility both locally reinterpret or rebuild some awareness.
capabilities.expected_behavior: All surfaces should describe the same event from the same canonical truth model.

capabilities.name: infrastructure_event_correlation
capabilities.current_behavior: Grouped outages and recoveries are inferred and emitted as parent incidents.
capabilities.expected_behavior: Shared infrastructure incidents should suppress notification storms and expose one coherent operational event.

capabilities.name: notification_policy_centralization
capabilities.current_behavior: Notification routing, category normalization, and decision policy are centralized.
capabilities.expected_behavior: Modules should not bypass the canonical notification policy.

capabilities.name: memory_unification
capabilities.current_behavior: Memory exists across resident_memory, home_timeline, execution ledger, device counters, and conversation threads.
capabilities.expected_behavior: Memory should be explainable and queryable as one coherent operational layer.

capabilities.name: digital_twin_object_readiness
capabilities.current_behavior: Signals and targets already carry reusable estate/building/room/device relationships, but object-scoped conversation is not generalized beyond some surfaces.
capabilities.expected_behavior: Twin objects should reuse the same identity, awareness, activity, relationship, and conversation contract.

gaps: generalized object contract not shared outside devices
full canonical conversation ownership not settled

strengths: room pages and room identifiers exist
operations exist in compatibility conversation layer
gaps: not clearly lifted into canonical runtime conversation

strengths: workflow awareness and assignment operations exist
gaps: shared object contract and delay/explanation flow need alignment

strengths: wallet runtime and service registry exist
gaps: object-bound conversational continuity is weaker than devices
local fallback intelligence builders remain active

recommended_phases: align frontend consumers to one truth model
expand memory and twin-ready object reasoning
